about: Zephaniah told God's people to turn back to Him, and promised that God would sing over them with joy.

pages.title: God Sings Over You
pages.scene: A happy child under a starry sky
pages.text: Zephaniah warned people to stop doing wrong. Then he shared good news: "The Lord your God is with you. He is very happy with you. His love will calm you. He will sing over you with joy!"
pages.lesson: God loves you and sings over you with joy.
